sections.title: Ecosystem & Flora
sections.content: The **Celestial Forest** is characterized by luminescent purple grass and glowing leaves emitting light (Level 10).

sections.title: Resources Found
sections.content:
- **Celestial Wood:** Excellent for crafting explosion-resistant structures.
- **Light Lotus:** Rare flower used in levitation potions.
